title: Epsilon-Optimal Strategy
body_html:
Epsilon-Optimal Strategy

Given $\varepsilon>0$, a strategy of player 1 is maxmin $\varepsilon$-optimal if it guarantees $\underline v-\varepsilon$. If the game has a value, such a strategy is simply called $\varepsilon$-optimal. A $0$-optimal strategy is an optimal strategy. The dual definition applies to player 2.
